GPU: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
restriction: CUDA Green Context; resource count queried and hardware SM-ID probe verified
fixed188_meaning: Actual hardware restriction remains 80 SM; official FLASH_ATTENTION_NUM_SMS=188 environment override preserves baseline host planner input. This is an experimental control, not the default deployment configuration.
timing: CUDA Graph, 10 attention calls per captured graph, 10 graph replays per timing sample (100 calls), 9 rounds with shuffled arm order, CUDA events, median per call
cache_policy: warm replay; no explicit L2 flush; not directly comparable to original PR cold-cache decode numbers
clock_policy: No host clock or power-limit changes; GPU clocks unlocked
correctness: All arms use identical tensors within each case; finite and abs_diff <= 0.02 + 0.02*abs(reference)
profiling: All cases, all three arms: LaunchStats + Occupancy + InstructionStats + local L1 sectors, separate profiler GPU; actual SM count verified per launch
interpretation: Green Context restricts SM resources but retains the same GPU memory system. This experiment does not emulate every property of a physically smaller GPU or independently vary RF capacity at fixed compute resources.
scope: Existing reconstructed PR public-range inventory, not author original254 row identity or exhaustive combinations of optional features.
